person.name: Peter Dinklage
person.summary: Peter Dinklage is an American actor best known for his role as Tyrion Lannister in Game of Thrones. He won a record four Primetime Emmy Awards for his performance.
person.biography: Peter Dinklage is an American actor. Born in New Jersey, he studied acting at Bennington College and began his career in amateur stage productions before making his film debut in Living in Oblivion. He gained recognition for his breakthrough role in The Station Agent and later achieved mainstream success portraying Tyrion Lannister in the HBO series Game of Thrones, for which he won a record four Primetime Emmy Awards. Dinklage's other notable film appearances include Elf, X-Men: Days of Future Past, and Avengers: Infinity War. He has also lent his voice to video games and has a significant theater background, performing in roles like Richard III and Cyrano de Bergerac.

person.name: Kit Harington
person.summary: English actor Kit Harington is best known for his role as Jon Snow in Game of Thrones. He also appeared in Eternals and How to Train Your Dragon 2.
person.biography: Kit Harington is an English actor. A graduate of the Royal Central School of Speech & Drama, he began his professional acting career in the West End play War Horse. Harington achieved widespread recognition for his role as Jon Snow in the acclaimed HBO fantasy series Game of Thrones, a performance that earned him Golden Globe and Emmy nominations. He has also acted in films such as Eternals, Pompeii, and voiced Eret in the animated How to Train Your Dragon film series. Beyond his television and film work, Harington has maintained a presence in theatre, appearing in various West End productions.

person.name: David Benioff
person.summary: American novelist, screenwriter, and producer best known for co-creating the HBO series Game of Thrones. He also wrote the screenplay for Troy and Gemini Man.
person.biography: David Benioff is an American novelist, screenwriter, and producer. Born in New York City, he earned a Master of Fine Arts degree in creative writing from the University of California, Irvine. Benioff is best known for co-creating the acclaimed HBO series Game of Thrones with D. B. Weiss, adapting George R. R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire book series. His other notable screenwriting credits include Troy and Gemini Man. He and Weiss also directed three episodes of Game of Thrones, and have since signed a major deal with Netflix.

person.name: George R.R. Martin
person.summary: George R.R. Martin is an American author and television producer. He is best known for the epic fantasy novel series A Song of Ice and Fire, adapted as Game of Thrones, and its prequel House of the Dragon.
person.biography: George R.R. Martin is an American author, screenwriter, and television producer. Born in Bayonne, New Jersey, he began writing and selling stories as a child. Martin earned journalism degrees from Northwestern University and worked as a VISTA volunteer before focusing on writing. He is best known as the author of the epic fantasy novel series A Song of Ice and Fire, which was adapted by HBO into the award-winning television series Game of Thrones and its prequel House of the Dragon. Martin also contributed to the video game Elden Ring. He was called "the American Tolkien" and named one of Time's 100 most influential people.
